newsitem.title: USA: Tropical Storm Marie weakening in W.Pacific - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Tropical Storm Marie weakening in W.Pacific - WSC.

text.p: Tropical Storm Marie remains a moderate to significant threat to shipping in the open western Pacific but its top winds of 65 mph are expected to weaken slowly, independent forecaster Weather Services Corp said on Monday.
The storm is near 33n/176e in the western Pacific, moving east-northeast at 33 mph and becoming extratropical.
